newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N steady, tax seen factor on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N steady, tax seen factor on Thursday.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished at 19.50 percent in routine trading on Tuesday, unchanged from Tuesday's close and a little weaker than 19.875 percent in the first deal, dealers said.
Thursday's tax payments have not had any impact on prices yet, but may have tomorrow, dealers added.
"They (tax payments) haven't affected the market yet, may be tomorrow's overnight rates will reflect that," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
